## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vedanāttika* ("The Triad of Feelings") is a structural section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral; Nyanatiloka 1938]. In the systematic classification of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the *Vedanāttika* constitutes the second triad of the Abhidhamma mātikā, following the *Kusalattika* [Nyanatiloka 1938]. The material of this triad is systematically treated across analytical frameworks including chapters on conditionality, support (*nissaya-vāra*), conjunction (*saṃsaṭṭha-vāra*), association (*sampayutta-vāra*), and investigation (*pañha-vāra*) [Nyanatiloka 1938].
No cross-language parallels or early external versions in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are identified for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal reuse within the Pali Abhidhamma, registering 268 matching passages across 43 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Major textual alignments occur with other treatments of the feeling triad throughout the *Paṭṭhāna*, such as *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 1.3, with 50 matches), *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 11.1, with 22 matches), *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 13.2, with 8 matches), *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 17.1, with 13 matches), and *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.10, with 10 matches) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, DharmaNexus records notable shared text with chapters of the *Vibhaṅga*, particularly the *Dhammahadayavibhaṅga* (Vb 18, 9 matches) and the *Khandhavibhaṅga* (Vb 1, 18 matches) [DharmaNexus].
